notFound.title: You've wandered off the map
notFound.text: This page doesn't exist. Let's get you back on the trail.

walkNotFound.title: This walk doesn't exist
walkNotFound.text: The route you're looking for may have moved, or it isn't available yet.

playError.title: Something went wrong
playError.text: The walk stopped unexpectedly, for example because of a weak connection. Your progress is normally saved on this phone.
playError.startOverMessage: This deletes the saved progress for this walk on this phone and starts again from the first stop.

globalError.title: Something went wrong
globalError.text: This page couldn't be shown. Please try again in a moment.
